name: settlement threshold
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 用于控制路基变形的允许沉降界限。
usage_overview: 用于将行车安全要求或车辆响应限值转化为路基沉降幅值的控制界限，支持过渡段及长距离沉降的评价。所确定的阈值对应给定的车辆、运行速度和结构条件。

complete_examples.text: It can be observed that the settlement threshold decreases with the vehicle speed rising.
When the CRH380A vehicle passes the transition zone at 350km/h, the settlement threshold of Pier 6 is 28mm.
